document.about: TI TPS543x step-down converter data sheet. Its typical-characteristics graphs are drawn as vectors, each x-axis titled under its row of tick values.

notes: #241: the graphs' axis titles were headings. A line set directly under a row of three or more bare values spanning it is the axis's title.

checks.issue: `I - Output Current - A`, an x-axis title under `0 0.5 1 1.5 …`, was a heading.
`Efficiency - %`, an axis title, was a heading.
Guard: `5.1 Absolute Maximum Ratings` stays a heading.
